rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Cal, Ben, Fay, Eli, Ada, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. Six claims of 1 fit in the bank's 8 to 12 tokens, so all of us can pay our end-of-round token. Taking more only risks someone being left short. Bank tokens we don't need should stay in the bank for later rounds.

Ben.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That's enough to cover the end-of-round token for all six, and the bank (6 plus at least 2 delivered) can cover six claims of 1. Greedy claims would leave some of us out of the game. Let's keep claims modest and share what's left.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims only what they need to survive, 1 token each this round. Six claims of 1 fit easily in the bank's 6 plus delivery, so everyone can pay their end-of-round token and the bank isn't drained. Greedy claims just push people out.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. The bank holds 6 before delivery, so 6 single claims are fully covered and everyone can pay their one token. Taking more only shrinks everyone's share and risks someone going without.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 this round. The bank holds 6 plus delivery, so every claim fits and everyone can pay their 1 token and survive. Over-claiming only shrinks everyone's share and puts people at risk. Let's keep claims to what we need to survive.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token this round. That covers the end-of-round spend for all six of us, and it leaves the bank with spare tokens for later rounds. Claiming more only drains the bank and risks someone being shut out.

Cal.say: Same as last round: everyone claims 1. The bank has 3 now, so the pool is 5 to 9 after delivery. If the delivery is only 2, the pool of 5 can't cover six claims of 1, so claiming more would only make that worse. Let's all take 1 and keep the bank as full as we can.

Ben.say: Same as last round: claim 1 each. The bank has 3 plus delivery of 2 to 6, so six claims of 1 are covered whenever the delivery is 3 or more. Anyone who claims more just cuts the shares for everyone, and the rest of us go short.

Fay.say: Same proposal as last round: everyone claims 1. The bank holds 3 now, plus a delivery of 2 to 6, so 5 to 9 tokens are available for six claims of 1. If the delivery is small, we share proportionally, so let's all keep to 1 and no one takes more than they need.
